standard_name: DEMO STANDARD: Process Safety & Chemical Engineering Limits
description: Demonstration rules for chemical process reactor concentrations, thermal runaways, and flash point safety.

rules.description: Aqueous solution reactant concentration must not exceed critical safety limit of 10.0%.
rules.reference: OSHA Process Safety Management 1910.119 / CCPS Reactive Hazards

rules.description: Exothermic reactor batch temperature must not exceed runaway threshold of 120°C.
